Mia: Heads up — saw a TP all-reduce latency regression after the kernel-selection patch landed. 8k-32k message sizes are showing ~2.4x tail latency compared to baseline.

Jordan: Repro steps? machine / job config?

Mia: repro script: `bench_tp_allreduce --gpus 8 --msg 8192 --iters 200 --model tp_f32`
Mia: quick output snippet: ```
msg=8192 iters=200 avg=4.8ms p95=12.1ms p99=18.3ms
baseline p95 ~5.0ms p99 ~7.6ms
```

Sam: hmm that's the msgsize regime where we flip from chunked allreduce->single-shot. Did kernel-selector change the chunk boundary?

Mia: yes, new selector prefers fused-kernel path for seq_len>1024 and sets chunk_k=2 for comm scheduling. The change was intended to reduce kernel launches, but looks like it increases NCCL pipelining overhead.

Ashley: could be comm/compute overlap breakage. Are we stalling on injects because KV cache flushes are happening between microbatches?

Mia: good call. I saw KV cache eviction spikes in the same trace. Clip from perf: ```
[trace] step=42 kv_evictions=3 kv_flush_ms=1.2 allreduce_sec=0.015
[trace] step=43 kv_evictions=0 kv_flush_ms=0.1 allreduce_sec=0.045
```

Jordan: the p99 jump when kv_evictions==0 is interesting — suggests that when KV isn't flushing we hit a different comm pattern? can you post the nccl topo and algorithms chosen?

Mia: nccl topo (nvlink on hosts): `rings: 0-1-2-3-4-5-6-7, trees: auto`
Mia: NCCL alg chosen in the failing run: `ring` for msg>=4k, but when chunk_k=2 we end up splitting into odd-sized packets causing extra rendezvous.

Sam: try forcing `NCCL_ALGO=tree` locally and see if p99 improves — tree usually better for mid-size msgs on our topology.

Mia: ran that: ```
NCCL_ALGO=tree bench_tp_allreduce ...
avg=5.0ms p95=6.0ms p99=8.1ms
```
Mia: p99 back to near baseline.

Ashley: so two interacting factors: kernel-selector changes chunking (small extra fragments) + kvcache timing causing less overlap. Both together amplify p99.

Jordan: can we add a heuristic: if msg in [4k,32k] prefer tree or set chunk_k=1? Also detect kv_flush density and avoid chunking when KV eviction rate high.

Mia: I'll prototype a short-circuit: if current_batch_kv_eviction_rate > 0.5 then disable chunking. Patch idea: ```diff
- if (msg >= CHUNK_THRESHOLD) chunk_k = 2;
+ if (msg >= CHUNK_THRESHOLD && kv_eviction_rate < 0.5) chunk_k = 2;
```

Sam: also add an override flag `--force-tree` to the bench harness so we can do A/B quickly in CI.

perf-bot: perf-dashboard updated: https://perf.internal/redwood/TP/2257890123 (flamegraphs + nccl trace attached) :bar_chart: 

Mia: I'll submit a small revert/guard and run the nightly perf suite. Thanks for the quick triage.

Jordan: awesome — also add a unit test that simulates high kv eviction density and verifies we don't chunk in that case.

Ashley: logging request: emit reason-code when we choose kernel path (e.g., "chunking_disabled: kv_eviction_high") so we can correlate in prod traces.

Mia: adding logs + PR in a bit. will tag y'all. :thumbsup:
